title: 全球与本地营销分工调整，怎样让团队对齐？
topic: 用清晰的全球规则、区域例外和分阶段执行对齐合作伙伴

source.title: The Coca-Cola Company Selects Agency Partners to Accelerate the Future of Marketing
source.section: The Coca-Cola Company Selects Agency Partners to Accelerate the Future of Marketing
source.type: 可口可乐官方全球营销合作与运营模式调整公告
source.context: The Coca-Cola Company 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
paragraphs: Coca-Cola will retain WPP Open X as its media partner globally, with the exception of North America, Japan and South Korea.
Coca-Cola has selected Omnicom as its media partner in North America. Omnicom will work closely with WPP StudioX.
Dentsu will continue to handle media in Japan and South Korea, which was not part of the current review.
WPP Open X will continue to serve as Coca-Cola’s global creative partner, which was not part of the current review.

The appointment of Omnicom in North America reflects Coca-Cola's commitment to aligning specialized capabilities with market-specific opportunities. By bringing media, data, CRM, loyalty and creators together within one connected ecosystem, the North America operating unit can move beyond channel-based execution toward more integrated consumer experiences. This evolution will further accelerate NAOU’s marketing transformation and strengthen the ability to create meaningful connections that drive growth.
The new structure will be implemented in phases beginning Dec. 1.
translations: 可口可乐将继续由 WPP Open X 担任全球媒体合作伙伴，北美、日本和韩国除外。
可口可乐选择 Omnicom 担任北美媒体合作伙伴。Omnicom 将与 WPP StudioX 密切合作。
Dentsu 将继续负责日本和韩国的媒体业务，这两个市场不在本次评估范围内。
WPP Open X 将继续担任可口可乐的全球创意合作伙伴，这项合作也不在本次评估范围内。
在北美任命 Omnicom，体现了可口可乐将专业能力与各市场机会相匹配的承诺。通过把媒体、数据、客户关系管理、忠诚度计划和创作者资源整合到一个协同生态中，北美运营部门可以从按渠道执行，转向提供更整合的消费者体验。这一变化将进一步推动北美营销转型，并加强通过有意义的消费者连接促进增长的能力。
新的组织架构将从 12 月 1 日开始分阶段实施。
fullTextParagraphs: ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- The Coca-Cola Company today announced the completion of a global marketing operating system review, reaffirming its commitment to building a world-class marketing ecosystem designed to drive growth, strengthen consumer connections and unlock the next generation of capabilities powered by data, technology and AI.
Coca-Cola will retain WPP Open X as its media partner globally, with the exception of North America, Japan and South Korea.
Coca-Cola has selected Omnicom as its media partner in North America. Omnicom will work closely with WPP StudioX.
Dentsu will continue to handle media in Japan and South Korea, which was not part of the current review.
WPP Open X will continue to serve as Coca-Cola’s global creative partner, which was not part of the current review.

“We began this process with a clear objective: ensure we have the right partners, capabilities and operating model to continue to lead in a rapidly changing marketing landscape,” said Manolo Arroyo, Executive Vice President and Chief Marketing and Customer Commercial Officer, The Coca-Cola Company. “The outcome reinforces our confidence in the strength of our global marketing ecosystem and positions us to accelerate growth through deeper consumer understanding, greater agility and the responsible application of emerging technologies.”

Since the creation of Open X in 2021, WPP has played a central role in helping Coca-Cola modernize its marketing approach across more than 200 countries and territories. “WPP delivered a stellar performance during the reviews, demonstrating their strong, modern media, tech and data capabilities,” Arroyo said. “Their data solution Open Intelligence builds on proven results from our FIFA World Cup 2026 activation across the world.”

WPP retains creator, media and marketing. WPP also delivered thought leadership in Systems of Influence and strong capabilities in creators, and commerce/retail media supported by one connected ecosystem WPP Open that integrates data, tech and AI capabilities, at scale, globally.

The appointment of Omnicom in North America reflects Coca-Cola's commitment to aligning specialized capabilities with market-specific opportunities. By bringing media, data, CRM, loyalty and creators together within one connected ecosystem, the North America operating unit can move beyond channel-based execution toward more integrated consumer experiences. This evolution will further accelerate NAOU’s marketing transformation and strengthen the ability to create meaningful connections that drive growth.

“Our review was about designing the future of our marketing organization,” Arroyo said. “The best marketing systems are built when you combine the best marketing talent with the right partnerships. We are confident that this combination of global scale, local expertise, innovation and collaboration gives us exactly that.”
The new structure will be implemented in phases beginning Dec. 1.

The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE: KO) is a total beverage company with products sold in more than 200 countries and territories. Our company’s purpose is to refresh the world and make a difference. We sell multiple billion-dollar brands across several beverage categories worldwide. Our portfolio of sparkling soft drink brands includes Coca-Cola, Sprite and Fanta. Our water, sports, coffee and tea brands include Dasani, smartwater, vitaminwater, Topo Chico, BODYARMOR, Powerade, Costa, Georgia, Fuze Tea, Gold Peak and Ayataka. Our juice, value-added dairy and plant-based beverage brands include Minute Maid, Simply, innocent, Del Valle, fairlife and Santa Clara. We’re constantly transforming our portfolio, from reducing sugar in our drinks to bringing innovative new products to market. We seek to positively impact people’s lives, communities and the planet through water replenishment, packaging recycling, sustainable sourcing practices and carbon emissions reductions across our value chain. Together with our bottling partners, we employ more than 700,000 people, helping bring economic opportunity to local communities worldwide. Learn more at www.coca-colacompany.com and follow us on Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn.

notes.phrase: with the exception of North America, Japan and South Korea
notes.meaning: 全球媒体合作由 WPP 负责，但北美、日本和韩国例外。
notes.explain: with the exception of… 用来说明一般规则中的例外地区。
notes.example: We use the global platform, with the exception of two local markets.

notes.phrase: Omnicom will work closely with WPP StudioX.
notes.meaning: Omnicom 在北美媒体业务中会与 WPP StudioX 密切合作。
notes.explain: work closely with 说明合作关系仍在，不是两个团队各自独立。
notes.example: Our regional team will work closely with the global creative group.

notes.phrase: aligning specialized capabilities with market-specific opportunities
notes.meaning: 把专业能力配置到符合各市场特点的机会中。

notes.example: We are aligning local expertise with market-specific opportunities.

scenario.title: 跨国营销协作：全球伙伴与区域团队分工
english: Your company has appointed a global media partner but selected a different partner for North America.
The regional teams need to keep creative work connected while adapting data and media plans to local markets.
Explain the general rule, name the exception, clarify how the partners will work together, and set a phased start date.
chinese: 公司已任命全球媒体合作伙伴，但北美地区选择了另一家合作伙伴。
各区域团队需要保持创意工作衔接，同时根据本地市场调整数据和媒体方案。
请说明一般安排、指出例外、讲清合作伙伴如何协作，并给出分阶段开始时间。

firstAttempt.prompt: 全球营销伙伴刚调整，各地区的合作分工不同。请用英语说明全球安排、区域例外、双方协作方式和执行时间。
firstAttempt.sample: Coca-Cola will retain WPP Open X as its global media partner, except in North America, Japan, and South Korea. Omnicom will handle North America and work closely with WPP StudioX; Dentsu will continue in Japan and South Korea. The new structure will be implemented in phases beginning December 1, so each region should confirm its owner and transition plan.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先说全球默认安排，再列地区例外和协作关系，最后交代落地时间与区域下一步。

words.collocation: global coverage with the exception of + place
words.example: The global process applies, with the exception of Japan.
words.translation: 全球流程适用，日本除外。
words.note: 用于说明规则或安排中的例外。

words.example: We need a market-specific plan for the North American launch.
words.translation: 北美上市需要一份针对该市场的计划。
words.note: 说明做法要适应某个具体地区的机会和条件。

words.collocation: implement a new structure in phases
words.example: We will implement the new partner model in phases.
words.translation: 我们将分阶段实施新的合作伙伴模式。
words.note: 分批推进，便于各地区安排交接和适应变化。

structure.original: The appointment of Omnicom in North America reflects Coca-Cola's commitment to aligning specialized capabilities with market-specific opportunities.
analysis: The appointment of… 是主语，指出具体的组织决定。
reflects 表示这一决定体现了什么方向。
align A with B 表示把专业能力与市场机会相匹配。
structure.transfer: The appointment of a local service partner reflects our commitment to aligning regional expertise with customer needs.

rewrite.bad: Every region can work with whoever they want.
rewrite.good: WPP Open X will remain our global media partner, with the exception of North America, Japan, and South Korea. Omnicom will lead media in North America and work closely with WPP StudioX. The new structure will be implemented in phases beginning December 1.
rewrite.translation: WPP Open X 将继续担任我们的全球媒体合作伙伴，北美、日本和韩国除外。Omnicom 将负责北美媒体业务，并与 WPP StudioX 密切合作。新架构将从 12 月 1 日起分阶段实施。
rewrite.pattern: [Partner] will remain the global [role], with the exception of [markets]. [Local partner] will lead [scope] and work closely with [team]. We will implement the change in phases beginning [date].

cloze.prompt: The global arrangement applies, with the ______ of North America.
cloze.why: with the exception of + 地区表示该地区不适用一般安排。

cloze.prompt: Omnicom will work closely ______ WPP StudioX.
cloze.why: work closely with 表示密切合作。

cloze.prompt: The new structure will be implemented in ______.
cloze.why: in phases 表示分阶段推进。

choice.prompt: 全球媒体合作伙伴已确定，但日本和韩国仍由原伙伴负责。哪种通知最清晰？
options: We have a global partner now. Ask your region if you have questions.
The global partner will lead media, with the exception of Japan and South Korea, where the current partner will continue. The new structure will start in phases on December 1.
Every market should use the new partner immediately.
choice.why: 第二条说明了默认规则、例外市场和实施时间。

output.prompt: 你的公司任命了全球客服平台供应商，但日本继续使用本地系统。请给区域负责人写两三句，说明全球安排、例外和分阶段切换时间。
output.sample: The new platform will be used globally, with the exception of Japan, where the local system will remain in place for now. Regional teams will work with the global support group to confirm data and training needs. We will implement the transition in phases beginning January 15.

给出交接协作和分阶段时间
